type.description: Type of tooltip display. - icon: Shows only an icon. - label: Shows text with optional leading icon. Default: label

variant.description: Visual style and semantic meaning of the tooltip. - normal (default): Standard informational tooltip. - enhanced: Highlighted/important notification (blue). - eco: Environmental/positive state (green). - raised:...

label.description: Text content displayed in the tooltip (only used when type="label"). Default: 'Label' Available when type==label.

showIcon.description: Whether to show the leading icon when type="label". Has no effect when type="icon". Default: false Available when type==label.

iconName.description: The icon in the `icon` slot, by name (a bundled icon); empty puts none. Leading icon slot (shown when type="icon" or type="label" with showIcon=true)

componentSize.description: Component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
